source.title: OS OpenMap–Local Building feature definition
source.license: OS OpenData product; exact licence text not stated in selected feature-definition window

evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's official OS OpenMap–Local Building feature definition states that a Building is a built entity that includes a roof and that the Building feature has featureCode plus geometry, where geometry is a polygon representing the generalised building (GM_Surface). The selected public no-login feature-definition window contains no Crawford Hotel record and no building name, identity, or type/use attribute bound to that polygon.

field_evidence.footprint: Official OS OpenMap–Local Building definition says geometry is a polygon representing the generalised building (GM_Surface).
field_evidence.type_use: Selected Building feature definition exposes featureCode and geometry only; no building type/use attribute is present.
field_evidence.identity: Selected feature-definition window contains no Crawford Hotel/MDV105844 record or record identifier.
